_comment: The request ledger (design↔code pipeline contract §1). One entry per outstanding asset. CODE keeps building against procedural placeholders under the same assetId; DESIGN fills these in whenever ready. Status lifecycle: requested → in_progress → delivered → accepted|rejected → integrated.

requests.purpose: Player character; replaces the procedural Arthur. Highest-value asset in the game — the eye judges the character hardest and procedural does it worst (handover §9).
constraints: match the ~32x48 footprint of the current procedural sprite (feet at bottom_center)
left may be delivered as mirrored right if the design has no asymmetric details — note it in deviations if so
act frames carry the tool swing: frame 0 = raised, frame 1 = struck (hit lands between them)

requests.purpose: Storage chest (Phase 3). Placed in the world; opens a storage panel.
constraints: wood + iron banding to match the medieval settlement tone
open state unused today but wired the moment it lands

requests.purpose: Bed furniture (Phase 3). Sits on interior floor tiles; the sleep interaction points at it.
constraints: vertical orientation (headboard at top), reads inside a 3x2-tile room

requests.purpose: Table furniture (Phase 3). Interior decoration; later a crafting/eating surface.
constraints: leave the tabletop visually clear so items can be composited on it later

requests.purpose: Tier-2 (TIMBER HOME) roof — the visual payoff of the upgrade-in-place. Drawn over the same 5x4-tile footprint as the tier-1 thatch roof.
constraints: same silhouette/footprint as the tier-1 roof (172x116, chimney top-right at ~x130-152) so the swap is drop-in
timber shingles, visibly richer than tier-1 thatch — the upgrade must read at a glance

requests.purpose: The wandering trader's cart (Phase 4) — the first shop, parked near the camp. Becomes an NPC-owned stall in Phase 5.
constraints: wooden cart with a striped awning and visible goods on the counter — should read as 'trade here' at a glance

requests.purpose: Turnip crop growth stages (Phase 4), drawn over tilled soil.
constraints: stage 0 = sprout, last stage must clearly read 'ready to pull'
shares the 24x26 frame with all crops so the renderer stays generic
final stage is the harvestable orange pumpkin

requests.purpose: Freestanding crafted wall/fence segment (Phase 3). Current placeholder reuses the house wall face and reads too heavy.
constraints: should tile side-by-side seamlessly when placed in a row
lighter than the house walls — a palisade/fence feel
